activeProposal.title: Qualify real Tauri applications through Ferrum WebDriver

repair.rootCause: Embedded Tauri fixture pinned tauri-build 2.6.0 while tauri 2.11.5 requires tauri-build ^2.6.3, causing Cargo resolver failure before build on Linux and Windows.
repair.repairDetails: Pin the temporary fixture to tauri-build 2.6.3 and explicitly resolve and print the coherent Tauri 2.11.5 runtime family before building.

activeProposal.mandatoryMergeGate: The exact repaired proposal must pass the full affected Ferrum CI surface plus embedded Tauri Linux and Windows real application launch, W3C session creation, real UI input/click, Rust greet IPC, screenshot/source capture, app/runtime identity and clean teardown. The direct tauri-driver path remains reference/diagnostic evidence and cannot substitute for mandatory cross-platform embedded proof.

ecosystemRotation: visual grounding, complete-screen parsing, screenshot fallback, GUI-agent benchmarks and computer-use reproducibility

researchConclusion.topExperiment: ScreenParse versus OmniParser on one fixed Ferrum-owned screenshot corpus before any optional visual fallback provider is integrated.
researchConclusion.reason: ScreenParse models complete visible-element parsing with locations, semantic types, text and hierarchy, which maps more naturally to Ferrum evidence than sparse coordinate grounding. OmniParser is the strongest active alternative and added a YOLOv9-E detector in July 2026.
researchConclusion.secondaryTechnique: Test UI-Venus-style bounded zoom/multiscale refinement only after a reproducible first-pass ambiguity exists.
researchConclusion.benchmarkHarvest: OSWorld-V2 immutable release/task/data/website/provider-image manifests are a strong reproducibility pattern for future Ferrum general-app benchmark packs.
researchConclusion.guardrail: Accessibility/native/WebDriver/CDP paths remain authoritative. Visual parsing is additive fallback or benchmark only, must retain the raw screenshot, and must expose uncertainty instead of inventing semantic identity.

Create one fixed Ferrum-owned visual benchmark corpus and compare ScreenParse b294659b... versus OmniParser 35402120... on recall, box accuracy, text/type correctness, median/p95 latency, startup, memory and output bytes while retaining every raw screenshot.
Only if that baseline exposes reproducible ambiguity, test bounded UI-Venus ZoomIn/multiscale refinement and count added model/tool round trips.
Audit general-app benchmark manifests against OSWorld-V2 immutable release/provenance requirements before importing external long-horizon tasks.
guardrails: No viewport/item caps, reduced datasets, hidden evidence, weaker tests, synthetic substitution, stale caching or reduced target coverage.
Visual parsing is additive fallback/benchmark only and cannot override structured accessibility, native automation, WebDriver/CDP or raw screenshot evidence.
PR #47 stays off main until its exact final proposal proves real Tauri Linux and Windows end-to-end plus the full affected regression surface.
Research popularity is never implementation proof; identical-workload evidence remains mandatory.
